_provenance: Derived ENTIRELY from one measurement: scripts/measure-silicon-power.py decision_hft_realbist — the signoff-clean netlist its ledger ships, gate-level simulated at its signoff clock, VCD-annotated OpenSTA report_power at each PVT corner with that corner's parasitics — plus the Hot Chips 2025 poster IMG_8874 for the external HiVec reference. Efficiency figures are computed from that power and clock and the tile count (E = P/f, TOPS/W = ops*f/P); energy_efficiency_lock.rs re-derives every figure.

typical_corner._note: the operating point is the 92.593 MHz signoff clock the VCD power was measured at (every timing corner meets it); 17-tile decision select-DAG, 1 cycle/decision. Control-dominated, so its win is energy-per-decision + single-cycle latency, NOT raw TOPS/W.

sota_comparison.source: this repo — VCD-measured on the signoff-clean netlist at its signoff clock (benchmarks/silicon/decision_fabric_power.json, scripts/measure-silicon-power.py)

sota_comparison.note: MAC-dense near-threshold; a different workload class than our control-heavy decision kernel
